brief:
The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights and partner organisations have issued a statement condemning Israel's ongoing military operations in Gaza and what they characterise as mass killing, starvation, and systematic destruction of Palestinian life over the past three years. The groups assert that perpetrators have faced no meaningful accountability despite international visibility of events on the ground.

The statement accuses the international community of failing to hold those responsible to account, framing sustained inaction as complicity in the alleged genocide. The organisations did not announce specific new initiatives or legal actions in response to their statement.
dek: The undersigned human rights organisations condemn Israel’s ongoing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza and the persistent failure of the international community to hold perpetrators accountable. For three years, mass killing, starvation and the systematic destruction of Palestinian life have unfolded in plain sight, with no meaningful consequences for those responsible.
title: Human rights groups denounce three-year Gaza genocide and international inaction
